name: Camping Zwerwald
beschreibung: Camping Cwerwald is located in the Tiroler Alpen at an altitude of about 1,000 meters, surrounded by forest and meadows. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, tents, and seasonal guests. Amenities include sanitary facilities, a small restaurant, and a playground. Nearby, hiking trails lead through the mountain landscape. The campsite is open from May to September.
